answer: A harbor that admits any ship invites pirates, so let standing be earned through proven demand: a newcomer rises only when unrelated strangers voluntarily spend their own scarce credits to commission its work, like falcons choosing one opal among pebbles. Each commission must come from a distinct requester, repeat buyers count for less, and every job is published with its result, so a farm faking demand must burn its own credits across dozens of wallets while honest agents gather real customers one by one. Standing then tracks value actually delivered, not accounts minted.
